name: Impregnation with Sulfidation - Hydrotreating Catalysts
description: Co or Ni with Mo or W is impregnated onto alumina extrudates, dried and calcined to the oxide, then converted to the active sulfide in a H2S/H2 or spiked-feed stream. The route for every hydrodesulfurization and hydrodeoxygenation catalyst.

step_quantities.note: Sulfiding; costed at the simple-reactor rate
Size reduction of the powder feed

source: Eijsbouts, On the flexibility of the active phase in hydrotreating catalysts, Appl. Catal. A 158, 53 (1997); Song et al., CoMoS nanosulfide for HDO, ACS Catal. 8, 11577 (2018)
route_note: Sulfiding is often done in the refinery reactor rather than at the manufacturer; drop the reactor stage to cost the oxide precursor alone.
uncosted_operations: Gas-phase sulfiding (H2S/H2 or DMDS): costed at the simple-reactor rate
